purpose: Estimate construction-agreement reliability from frozen, feature-only candidate predictions, then freeze at most one local-proxy shrink candidate. This is not target calibration.
explicitly_excluded: P4 and any LB-calibrated candidate or parameter
V2 (its registry forecast contains a public-score anchor, even though the candidate itself is model-only)
leaderboard/submission scores, scorecards, labels, removed references, or external data
scope: Official 9,379 GEOIDs in the four region sample files; read GEOID only from sample files.
predictor: Each frozen construction's coverage_gap_score, centered within region.

reliability_definition.per_construction_signal_share: clip(mean covariance of that construction with every other frozen construction / its own centered variance, 0, 1)
reliability_definition.combined_candidate_weights: Estimate each construction's signal share pooled across regions as total cross-covariance with the other constructions / total centered variance; normalize the nonnegative shares to sum to one globally. Use equal weights only if every share is zero.
reliability_definition.signal_variance: Weighted mean of pairwise centered cross-construction covariances, using products of normalized candidate weights and excluding diagonal terms.
reliability_definition.total_variance: Population variance across official tracts of the weighted combined predictor within the region.
reliability_definition.shrink_factor: c_r = clip(signal_variance / total_variance, 0, 1); c_r=0 if total_variance is zero.

region_specificity_rule: Use regional c_r only if max(c_r)-min(c_r) >= 0.10; otherwise use one pooled c from region-weighted centered covariance and total variance. Candidate weights remain global.
local_prediction_protocol: Leave one construction out in turn. Estimate weights, c, and regional means from the remaining constructions only; score the held-out construction against the shrink predictor using tract-weighted RMSE. This is a cross-construction generalization proxy, not organizer-target RMSE.
candidate_gate: Register S only if leave-one-construction-out pooled MSE improves on the unshrunk reliability-weighted training consensus and no more than one region has negative average MSE gain across held-out folds; otherwise report a negative/no-candidate result.
shrink_target_choice: Region mean, because the reliability estimate concerns within-region deviations and no label-free evidence identifies the target's global intercept as zero. No region mean is claimed to equal the hidden reference mean.
interpretation_gate: Cross-candidate covariance estimates shared construction signal only under uncorrelated construction errors. Shared source/model bias violates that assumption; report it as a reliability proxy and do not call it target accuracy.
